visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a tight close-up on a young boy, approximately five years old, with dark, slightly wavy hair. He is seated in a professional salon chair, draped in a white cutting cape. A stylist's hands are visible, meticulously using silver scissors and a black comb to trim the ends of his hair. The boy remains remarkably still, his gaze fixed downward with a calm, somewhat pensive facial expression. The background shows blurred elements of a modern hair salon, including black equipment and soft studio lighting. (2) The scene transitions to the salon's shampoo area. The boy is now lying back in a black reclining chair, his head resting in a white porcelain shampoo bowl. A female hairstylist, wearing a black apron and a white face mask, gently massages his scalp with soapy water. The water flows from a chrome nozzle, creating bubbles in his dark hair. The boy keeps his eyes mostly closed, appearing relaxed during the washing process. In the background, other salon stations and a few patrons are visible under bright, warm indoor lighting. (3) Back at the main styling station, the boy sits upright while the stylist begins the chemical application process. She uses a brush to apply a thick, white perming cream to specific sections of his hair, combing it through to ensure even coverage. The boy's expression remains neutral as he occasionally glances at a tablet screen positioned just out of frame. The stylist's hands, clad in clear plastic gloves, move with precision. Blue plastic clips are used to section off the treated hair, creating a structured look across his head. (4) The hairstylist begins rolling the boy's hair onto a multitude of small, colorful plastic perm rods in shades of yellow, pink, and blue. Each rod is secured with a thin rubber band or clip. A thick band of white cotton is wrapped around the boy's forehead to catch any excess liquid. He continues to watch the tablet, his patience evident as the 'curler-heavy' look takes shape. The camera angle shifts between eye-level and slightly high angles, capturing the intricate detail of the rods covering his entire scalp. (5) A large, silver and translucent plastic hood-style hair dryer is lowered over the boy's rod-covered head. He sits under the device for an extended period, with faint wisps of steam occasionally visible through the plastic dome. He looks slightly bored but resigned, still focused on his digital entertainment. The lighting in the salon remains bright and consistent, reflecting off the metallic surfaces of the dryer. In the background, a man in a striped shirt can be seen working at another station, adding to the bustling atmosphere. (6) In the final stage, the rods are removed, revealing tight, springy wet curls. The stylist uses a large black hair dryer with a diffuser attachment to gently dry the hair while applying white styling mousse from a pressurized can. She scrunches the curls with her hands to define the texture. The boy's face is finally seen with the completed look—a full head of voluminous, curly hair. He looks into the mirror, seemingly satisfied with his new appearance. The camera pans slightly to show the final result from different angles.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the loud, broadband white noise of a professional hair dryer. Overlapping this is an upbeat, medium-tempo pop BGM featuring electronic synthesizers and a steady drum beat. A female voice, speaking Traditional Chinese with a friendly and enthusiastic tone, introduces the video. The speech rate is moderate, and her pitch is relatively high, indicating excitement. Background noise is minimal due to the dominance of the dryer's mechanical roar, though faint echoes of the salon's ambient room tone are present. (2) A transition occurs as the dryer stops, replaced by the rhythmic sound of running water. There are distinct splashing and gurgling noises as the stylist rinses the boy's hair. The female voice continues, now in a softer, more intimate conversational volume. She asks the boy brief questions, characterized by a rising intonation. The boy's responses are very quiet, almost whispered, with a low arousal level. The BGM remains in the background but is more audible now that the dryer has ceased, providing a cheerful acoustic bed. (3) The sound of metallic scissors 'snicking' together and the plastic 'click' of hair clips being opened and closed are prominent. The hairstylist's voice maintains a professional and narrative tone, explaining the steps of applying the perm solution. The speech is clear and well-enunciated. There are occasional short pauses between sentences. The ambient noise floor includes the distant chatter of other people in the salon and the faint hum of an air conditioning unit. The BGM's beat is prominent, with a strong, repetitive percussion track. (4) A series of hissing sounds occur as a spray bottle is used repeatedly. This is followed by the rustling of plastic gloves and the soft 'thud' of perm rods being placed on a tray. The stylist's voice becomes more animated, laughing occasionally, which is reflected in a high pitch variability. The boy makes a short, high-pitched vocalization of agreement. The overall acoustic environment is 'wet' with reverb from the salon's hard surfaces. The BGM continues without interruption, maintaining a consistent energy level throughout this phase. (5) The audio shifts to a constant, low-frequency mechanical hum from the hood dryer. This creates a drone-like background that masks much of the subtler ambient noise. The hairstylist's voice is heard at a distance, talking to another person, with lower intensity and clarity. The BGM remains the primary melodic element, though its higher frequencies seem slightly dampened by the dryer's hum. There is a lack of sharp transients in this phase, creating a relatively stable and less dynamic acoustic texture for several seconds. (6) The loud, rushing sound of the handheld hair dryer returns with high intensity. Sharp, percussive 'pop' and 'hiss' sounds are heard as styling products are dispensed from an aerosol can. The stylist's voice swells in volume to be heard over the dryer, using a cheerful and complimentary tone. The BGM reaches a crescendo before fading out. The phase ends with the sound of the boy's soft voice and a final enthusiastic comment from the stylist. The signal-to-noise ratio is high, with the primary voices and dryer sounds clearly dominating.
